title: STMemoLLM: A Spatial-Temporal Memory-Augmented LLM for Robust Traffic Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2611.30148v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Traffic forecasting is essential for intelligent transportation systems. However, traditional deep-learning models often rely heavily on high-quality observations. Recent LLM-based approaches incorporate pretrained knowledge to improve forecasting, but they remain sensitive to input perturbations and struggle to preserve long-term patterns. To address this, we propose STMemoLLM, a spatial-temporal memory-augmented LLM for robust traffic forecasting. STMemoLLM introduces memory prototypes to compress inputs into compact summary tokens while extracting reliable dynamics from residual signals, achieving a balance between stability and variability. Specifically, a memory-enhanced tokenizer encodes prototypes and sensor characteristics into attention biases to guide adaptive compression of correlated sensors into semantic summary tokens. translated_title: STMemoLLM：一种用于鲁棒交通预测的时空记忆增强大语言模型
translated_abstract: 交通预测对智能交通系统至关重要。然而，传统深度学习模型通常严重依赖高质量的观测数据。近期基于大语言模型（LLM）的方法通过引入预训练知识来提升预测效果，但它们对输入扰动仍然敏感，且难以保留长期模式。为解决这些问题，我们提出了STMemoLLM，一种用于鲁棒交通预测的时空记忆增强大语言模型。STMemoLLM引入记忆原型，将输入压缩为紧凑的摘要令牌，同时从残差信号中提取可靠的动态信息，从而在稳定性与可变性之间实现平衡。具体而言，记忆增强分词器将原型和传感器特征编码为注意力偏置，引导将相关传感器自适应压缩为语义摘要令牌；记忆校准路由器进一步评估上下文偏差、压缩不足以及原型适配情况。（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: STMemoLLM通过记忆原型将输入压缩为紧凑的语义摘要令牌，并利用记忆校准路由器从残差信号中提取可靠动态，在稳定性与可变性之间取得平衡，从而实现对输入扰动更鲁棒的交通预测。
en_tdlr: STMemoLLM leverages memory prototypes to compress inputs into compact semantic summary tokens and employs a memory-calibrated router to extract reliable dynamics from residual signals, balancing stability and variability for robust traffic forecasting against input perturbations.
